notes: This humorous picture book is highly motivating for students — the silly topic (a boy who thinks his bum has a crack and needs a new one) generates genuine engagement and laughter. Priority vocabulary centres on the problem (rip, bum), attempted solutions (glue, tape, shop, robot bum, duck bum) and the resolution via mum. 'Robot' and 'duck' are kept as single words rather than compound phrases because slot space is limited and context makes meaning clear on the board. Existing activity_images already include bum, pants, rip, glue, tape, shop, robot bum, duck bum, store, mum — reuse those assets directly; 'robot' and 'duck' here refer to those same compound concepts and can reuse the 'robot bum' and 'duck bum' images respectively. Existing aac_extras (laugh, look, find, choose) complement this board well and can be added as supplementary vocabulary.
